boxes.meaning: to preserve, keep in good condition

english.note: Use this for keeping food or other things in good condition for later use.
Use this for keeping food from spoiling by storing or treating it for later use.

examples.english: We use salt to conserve the fish so it will keep for later.
examples.traditional: 我哋用鹽醃魚，保存耐啲留返日後食。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jung6 jim4 jim1 jyu4 bou2 cyun4 noi6 di1 lau4 faan2 jat6 hau6 sik6

examples.english: Preserve the plums in salt water, and they will keep longer.
examples.traditional: 用鹽水保存啲梅，可以放耐啲。
examples.jyutping: jung6 jim4 seoi2 bou2 cyun4 di1 mui4 ho2 ji5 fong3 noi6 di1
